banner.title: BIRTHRIGHTS AND TABLE 40, printed capture pp. 68-69 - the OA birthrights round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture alone for this range (the settling authority): the first Mistral-OCR capture session is unavailable above p. 33, so the cross-capture agreement check is impossible. No contested cells detected within the single source: the T40 bands run contiguously 1 through 100 and every honor value sits on its printed row. The T40 result column pins as the 0-11 code (blank 0, roll again 1, property share 2, horse 3, the 1-6 cash strings 4, armor of quality 5, the 1-8 cash strings 6, weapon of quality 7, the 1-4 horses 8, the 2-12 cash strings 9, the magical weapon 10, the d100 roll again 11); the die bands pin as the lo and hi bounds; the honor column is personal honor. OCR normalization: the print capitalization varies (Property Share at 6 and 17-18, Property share at 8, 41-45 and 56-60, Armor of quality and Weapon of quality at their rows) - all pin as the same codes; rows 4 and 7 read "next higher die or + 10" while row 100 reads "with + 10 on die roll" (the printed d100 doctrine - both pin as the roll-again codes 1 and 11). The Chapter 4 Honor prose (capture pp. 69-73) is deliberately left for the next rounds
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 74 closed, 161 open - the Birthrights prose and Table 40 boxes flip (census 555 -> 556); NEXT - R634: the Honor chapter opener, the Gaining and Losing Honor prose and Table 41 (Initial Honor), capture pp. 69-70, prefix dgu (verify free), audit "R634 OA honor audit", include after rules/oabr.h

consts.name: dgtPropShareMinPct
consts.comment: Property share prose (capture p. 69): the share lower bound, 10 percent of the yearly income

consts.name: dgtPropShareMaxPct
consts.comment: Property share prose (capture p. 69): the share upper bound, 30 percent of the yearly income

consts.name: dgtCashPerString
consts.comment: Cash strings prose (capture p. 69): each string holds 100 coins

consts.name: dgtMagicWeaponMaxPlus
consts.comment: Magical weapon prose (capture p. 69): never more magical than +2

consts.name: dgtFirstSonRollPenalty
consts.comment: Birthrights prose (capture p. 68): the first son subtracts one from the rolls allowed

bools.name: dgtBirthrightClanVirtue
bools.comment: Birthrights prose (capture p. 68): a birthright is something the character begins the game with, by virtue of his family clan - an heirloom or a share of the family holdings

bools.name: dgtBirthrightMayBeNothing
bools.comment: Birthrights prose (capture p. 68): it may be nothing, owing to poverty, birth order or chance

bools.name: dgtSharedClanOwnership
bools.comment: Birthrights prose (capture p. 68): once determined, the birthright is the property of both the player character and the family clan

bools.name: dgtDeathReturnsToClan
bools.comment: Birthrights prose (capture p. 68): if the player character dies, the birthright returns to the possession of the family clan

bools.name: dgtLostBirthrightLosesHonor
bools.comment: Birthrights prose (capture p. 68): if the character loses a birthright, he and his family lose honor

bools.name: dgtRollsDeterminedByT38
bools.comment: Birthrights prose (capture p. 68): the die type and the number of rolls were determined by Table 38: Character Birth

bools.name: dgtBirthRankReducesRolls
bools.comment: Birthrights prose (capture p. 68): the number of rolls allowed is modified by subtracting the character's birth rank

bools.name: dgtHonorIsPersonal
bools.comment: T40 honor prose (capture p. 68): the honor gained is personal, not family - it is added to the character's honor at the start of the game and does not increase the family base honor

bools.name: dgtPropShareAncestorLandsOnly
bools.comment: Property share prose (capture p. 69): the shares come only from the lands held by the father, the grandfather or the head of the family

bools.name: dgtPropShareSingleCap
bools.comment: Property share prose (capture p. 69): never more than a 30 percent share in a single property

bools.name: dgtPropShareNoPropertyRead
bools.comment: Property share prose (capture p. 69): if the family holds no productive property, the roll is treated as no result

bools.name: dgtHorseAnyTypeNoTack
bools.comment: Horse prose (capture p. 69): one or more horses of any type desired, without a saddle or other tack

bools.name: dgtCashStringDmCoinType
bools.comment: Cash strings prose (capture p. 69): the DM determines the type of coin in each string

bools.name: dgtQualityArmorDmWeaponPlayer
bools.comment: Heirloom prose (capture p. 69): the DM randomly determines the armor type; the player chooses the weapon type

bools.name: dgtQualityItemNotTransferable
bools.comment: Heirloom prose (capture p. 69): the items cannot be given away or sold, since they belong in part to the family, and are expected to pass on through the family

bools.name: dgtMagicWeaponSwordOrMisc
bools.comment: Magical weapon prose (capture p. 69): either a sword or a miscellaneous weapon, complete with history

bools.name: dgtMagicWeaponNoSpecialAbilities
bools.comment: Magical weapon prose (capture p. 69): the weapon has no special abilities

bools.name: dgtMagicWeaponNeverSold
bools.comment: Magical weapon prose (capture p. 69): the character can never give away or sell the item

bools.name: dgtMagicWeaponLostHonorLoss
bools.comment: Magical weapon prose (capture p. 69): losing the item and still living means a great loss of honor

bools.name: dgtRollAgainNextLargerDie
bools.comment: Roll again prose (capture p. 69): the next larger die (1d4 becomes 1d6, 1d6 becomes 1d8, etc.), or add 10 when already rolling d100
